Contrast Pairings

Color is only on-brand when it is legible. Classes: reading >= 4.5:1 (body, captions); labels and display >= 3.0:1 (kickers, tags, large type); decorative exempt (marks, washes, fills — never words).

typography.md · umbrella

Fraunces speaks, Hanken Grotesk works

Brand that agents read.

Fraunces — warm, literate, botanical — for headings and display with lively italics. Hanken Grotesk for body and interface. JetBrains Mono for code and annotations. Base 18px, editorial scale.

The brand lives in files agents read

A warm, characterful serif
body · Hanken Grotesk400 · 1.0625rem
A company spends months on its identity. petals carries it into every session, every project, without a hex code pasted into a prompt. Hanken Grotesk is a warm, friendly, rounded-humanist sans — legible and precise at body sizes.

How a box is finished

Radius from a fixed scale, ink-tinted shadows in two layers, and one motion idea — things unfold, never bounce. Shadows use rgba(58, 39, 24, ...) — the ink, tinted — never pure black.

Sentence case everywhere. Buttons are verb-first, three words or fewer. Product names stay lowercase: plotplot, tilth, tend, petals, pleach, umbel. No exclamation marks in interface copy. Errors state what happened, why it matters, and the next action — in that order.

products/petals/identity.md · products/petals/assets/logo.svg

Three petals, one stem

Vital leaf, vivid blossom, luminous petal — the palette itself, carried. The word stays calm beside it.

  • Copy products/petals/assets/logo.svg byte-for-byte — never redraw or recolor. The fills are exact.
  • Minimum 20px mark height; below that, the wordmark alone.
  • Clear space of half the mark's height on all sides.
  • Never stretch, rotate, outline, add effects, or use a single petal as the logo.
  • The wordmark is lowercase "petals", set whole, in ink.
